note: Written by hand (or by Claude in the morning briefing) from the daily levels. Each setup is a plan, not a signal. Not financial advice.

setups.why: The midterm result broke gold's run of lower highs: it closed back above the late-October high near 4,060 as the dollar and yields fell. Buy a pullback to that broken level.
setups.trigger: A pullback that holds 4,045 to 4,065 and turns up at the COMEX open.
setups.invalidation: A daily close back below 4,000, under the old sell zone.

setups.why: Still below every average after a 17% fall; the midterm bounce runs into the late-October closes and the 20-day average near 54.8.
setups.trigger: A failed bounce in the zone.
setups.invalidation: A daily close above the 20-day average, near 55.

setups.why: At the top of its 1.1103 to 1.1276 range, but the dollar is falling after the midterms: take it only on a clear rejection.
setups.trigger: A rejection at the range high in the London session; skip it if Friday's jobs report is ahead of the trade.

setups.why: The strongest trend of the five, at a 20-day high with the Bank of England expected to raise rates today. Buy a pullback to the breakout area, not the high.
setups.trigger: A pullback to 1.3400 to 1.3420 that holds after the 12:00 UK decision.

setups.why: Six weeks between 156 and 159. Buy the bottom of the range.
setups.trigger: A hold of 156 in the Tokyo or London session.
